bagPolicy.summary: Red Rocks Amphitheatre allows single-pocket bags and clear bags no larger than 13” x 15” x 8”. Small purses, fanny packs, and hydration packs up to 2L are also permitted.
allowed: Single pocket bags and clear bags no larger than 13” x 15” x 8”
Small purses and fanny packs that are 6″ x 9″ or smaller
Hydration packs up to 2L with no more than one additional pocket
prohibited: Any bag larger than 13″ x 15″ x 8″
bagPolicy.note: Patrons with prescription medication should bring only the necessary amount in the original container.

parking.summary: Concerto hasn't confirmed Red Rocks Amphitheatre's parking details from an official source yet. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.note: For drop-off, use the Top Circle Lot via Entrance 1 or the Red Rocks Park Road and Trading Post Road intersection via Entrance 2. After the show, meet your ride in the Jurassic Lot just inside Entrance 2 off Highway 93. Walk downhill using the Will Call Trail across from the Trading Post, then Red Rocks Park Road.

concessions.note: Red Rocks Amphitheatre offers a variety of food and drink options including BBQ, NY-style pizza, chicken sandwiches, gyros, tacos, smoothies, and specialty coffee. The Ship Rock Grille provides a unique dining experience with stunning views, though reservations are recommended for concert nights.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: ADA accessible seating. Accessible parking near venue. Shuttle from lower lots to accessible seating.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry policy varies by event, check your show's details.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Will Call and Box Office at venue entrance. Photo ID required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Main entrance via I-70 and Morrison. Arrive early, traffic backs up 1–2 hrs before shows.
